column1: # Manufacturer | result | verified official URL | findings requiring follow-up

3M|verified|https://multimedia.3m.com/mws/media/2414956O/3m-automotive-window-film-color-stable-cs-ir-series-product-bulletin-rev-c.pdf|May 2024 CS IR bulletin is distinct from legacy nano-carbon Color Stable. Preserve old and new generations.

ASWF|verified|https://aswf.com/product-category/automotive-films/|Carbon SX, Carbon SIR, Carbon Ultra, Carbon Ultra IR, CarbonS 4Mil, Excel IRP, Dimension IRP, Classic Pro Black, Classic Pro Charcoal, Retro Black, Retro Charcoal, Excel and Performer are official listings. 2026 brochure now backs 12 exact catalog series; older Carbon SIR and CarbonS 4Mil need separate identity/specialty review.
Autobahn|verified|https://autobahnwindowfilms.com/window-tint/|Four current tint lines confirmed. Local technical sheets cover Black, Black Ceramic and i3; a matching i3+ chart is still needed.

Avery Dennison|verified|https://graphics.averydennison.com/en/home/graphics-products/window-films/automotive-window-films.html|North American portfolio now lists Encore Supreme IR, Encore Shield IR, Encore Supreme and Encore. Asia-Pacific NR Nano Ceramic IR documentation is separate.

Ceramic Pro / KAVACA|verified|https://ceramicpro.com/window-tint/|Catalog and documents support the current Carbon X, Ceramic X, Ceramic IR, Ultimate IR series. Do not map Carbon CS warranty terms to Carbon X by name similarity.

CoolVu|access_gap|https://www.coolvu.com/dealer-store/automotive-films/|The registered automotive URL returned 404. Official current results provide architectural documents; no usable current auto product chart was verified.

Edge Film Technologies|verified|https://programedge.com/automotive-products/|Ceramic XR and Carbon Crystalline are already mapped. Clear Comfort and Spectra HP remain in the identity review queue. Source screenshot chart is low resolution.

Flexfilm|verified|https://flexfilmstore.com/collections/automotive-window-tint|Four current products confirmed. Published short-band and long-band IR data remain separate. Duraflex 15's printed UV qualifier is retained.
FormulaOne|verified|https://llumar.com/en/tint/formulaone/|Classic, Comfort, Pinnacle and Stratos. Reviewed 08/24 chart; comparisons require a comparable test setup.

Garware Hi-Tech Films|verified|https://www.garwarehitechfilms.com/|Official range includes Arctic Cool, Ice Cool Elite, Classic Lite, Glaze QDP Lite and International lines. This is separate from Global's US lineup; do not align based on names.

GeoShield|verified|https://geoshieldusa.com/collections/automotive-window-film|Pro Nano Black and Pro Classic Black appear beside separate Charcoal versions. Do not apply charcoal performance data to Black.

GLASSTINT|verified|https://www.glasstint.com/en|Official Nano Ceramic group lists Pender, Rode, Santana, Shure X, Camo. Reflective Ceramic group lists Sunset R, Reiney Blue and Aura. Six nano-ceramic variants now have shade specs. Rode Black has its own published chart.

Global|verified|https://globalwindowfilms.com/dms/globalwindowfilms/pdf/premium-automotive-specification.pdf|Manufacturer specification PDF works through its indexed endpoint despite the automotive index returning 403. Local booklet includes NR Quick Dry, NR Quick Dry Plus, HP Black, IR Extreme, IR Extreme Plus and Ice Cool variants requiring canonical mapping.
Helios Window Films|verified|https://helioswindowfilm.com/automotive/|Orbit, Nova and Super Nova confirmed. The category page does not state test substrate or wavelengths.

HITEK|verified|https://hitekfilms.com/automotive-window-tint/|Local charts are mapped to seven current lines. Ceramic Black absent from the supplied files; verify its missing data on the current lineup.
Hüper Optik|verified|https://www.huperoptik.com/automotive-solutions|Official global chart available for Traditional Series. Market availability and US warranty documentation need resolution.

Johnson Window Films|verified|https://johnsonwindowfilms.com/automotive/window-film-products/|Two local revisions disagree on some Supreme IR measurements. Neither chart substitutes for plastic substrate testing of PlexShade.
KDX|verified|https://kdxfilms.com/automotive-film/|Cosmic IR, Nova Carbon, Stellar Ceramic and King identified. Keep two separately labeled IR readings in historical evidence.

Kepler|verified|https://www.keplercoatings.com/automotive-window-film|Current official lineup shows Kepler Standard, Kepler IR and Kepler IR+. Summary heat-rejection claims do not supply a comparable method.
LLumar|verified|https://llumar.com/en/tint/|North American 08/25 test chart captured. AU 85 is its own UV Protection family and is not mapped to AIR.
Madico|verified|https://madico.com/automotive/window-tint|December 2025 local chart covers eight series. Black Pearl NC 10 shading coefficient is malformed in the original and withheld.

MaxPro|verified|https://maxprofilms.com/ceramic/|Automotive hub is indexed but returned an error when directly fetched. Official Max IR table is normalized. Other series, roll sizes and the exact Max IR test substrate remain open.

Nexfil|verified|https://nexfilusa.com/specifications/|Manufacturer lists separate automotive and architectural spec resources. Public auto chart mapped to six established identities. Unmapped economy, NRNX, and HP Centurion variants remain separate. Inconsistent solar totals are flagged.
Rayno|verified|https://raynofilm.com/window-film/automotive-window-film/|Current products validated against the manufacturer category. The warranty differentiates Phantom/Platinum Air and MonoCarbon.

Rogue|verified|https://roguewindowfilms.com/auto-films/|Existing four Eclipse families appear on official sources. Verify per-series terms rather than applying Eclipse IR's details to every Eclipse name.

Scorpion|verified|https://scorpionwindowfilm.com/automotive-film/|Five local product sheets provide quoted maxima and shade lists. These are product-level evidence; full shade performance matrices remain incomplete.

Solar Free|verified|https://solarfreefilm.com/products/|Official SolarFree has separate automotive and architectural categories. Automotive series, numeric charts, and market-specific warranty coverage need review.

Solar Gard|verified|https://www.solargard.com/automotive/automotive-window-tint/|XenithIR, VortexIR and HP Smoke Plus construction verified. Endeavor and Solstice need controlled construction mapping. Region-specific warranties are not interchangeable.
SolarFX|verified|https://solarfxwindowfilms.com/|Local screenshots supplement current series listings. A separate unidentified SolFX chart is held for identity review.

STEK|conflicting|https://www.stekautomotive.com/brands/stek/window-film/icy|Current ICY detail describes metallized film; the catalog records ceramic. Product classification is held for source and market reconciliation. ACTION SAFETY stays separate.

SunTek|verified|https://suntekfilms.com/na/en/automotive-window-tint/|Retained 04/24 chart; InfinityOP is in source discovery. Current availability should be confirmed before treating each historical shade as orderable.
UCA Window Film|verified|https://ucafilm.com/|Local chart has three automotive series. Its printed IR wavelength unit is unresolved and unsuitable for a cross-brand ranking.
Union Window Films|verified|https://unionwindowfilms.com/|Manufacturer's own lineup and technology materials found. Detailed, market-specific product and warranty matrix remains open.
Uviron|conflicting|https://uviron.com/collections/window-film|Current three product identities confirmed. Existing conflicting product-level headline numbers remain separate from shade-level data.

XPEL|verified|https://www.xpel.com/product-specifications|US R0523 chart captured; separate single-wavelength IRR and band-integrated IRER. Warranty transfer terms need confirmation due to contradictory public wording.
